Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (specifically the co-IP MS from HeLa cells) focuses on comparing the composition of TAF11-containing complexes between the cytosolic and nuclear compartments. While the paper describes extensive in vitro biochemical perturbations (TBP binding, TAF1-TAND competition) and yeast genetic mutants, these are not the primary variables of the MS-analyzed HeLa cell samples described in the PRIDE metadata and the 'Human TFIID' IP section.
